study_question: Does a causal discrete-time hazard model on HAR+return features predict which event occurs first within H minutes — target hit (+thr) vs stop hit (−thr) vs neither — better than chance and trivial baselines?

label.construction: From decision bar close C0, scan completed 1m bars forward up to horizon minutes; first time close>=C0+thr → target; close<=C0-thr → stop; else neither. thr = median |train outcome_hz_pts| of non-zero moves.

primary_metric.name: MCC
primary_metric.screen: same advancement screen as elastic_net_eval_v1 (adapted to 3 survival classes)
